positive.prompt: Set up this existing monorepo so Codex and Claude can work in it without duplicating instructions.
Bootstrap agent-facing documentation for this new repository.
Create a lean AGENTS.md and move recurring procedures into repo skills.

negative.prompt: Write an ADR for the database choice we just made.
Review this pull request for correctness regressions.

evals.prompt: Retrofit the supplied existing repository for agentic coding across Codex, Claude, and Copilot. Inspect it and present the plan before changing anything.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based inventory and proposed documentation plan presented before any writes.
expectations: Enumerates the root, scoped, rules, workflow, ADR, copied skill files, bundled skill resources, and directory-symlink adapter in the fixture without following links outside the repo
Uses static CI and manifest evidence without executing repo-owned commands before approval
Matches the existing ADR convention instead of imposing a new location or template
Resolves the divergent skill copies and instruction files without assuming plain pointer files will load
Provides compatible scoped guidance for every requested tool instead of moving rules only to nested AGENTS.md
Shows current and projected line counts and requests confirmation before writing

evals.prompt: Set up the supplied README-only repository for agentic coding. Application scaffolding is not authorized.
evals.expected_output: A minimal documentation plan that does not invent commands, code, architecture, or empty documents.
expectations: Reads and uses the product direction already present in README.md before interviewing the user
Asks only for information that cannot be derived from the repository
Creates no application scaffold unless it is explicitly included in the approved plan
Includes only documents with substantive content
Proposes compatible native root instructions only for the tools in use
Does not fabricate retrospective decisions or gotchas
